# Eveoy MCP

> The Eveoy MCP server. Eveoy is the experience marketing platform built for verified
> in-store customer visits: you pay $24.99 per real customer who walks into your store,
> spends 10+ minutes, makes a purchase, and brings back ~2 quality-rated photos. Tiers:
> Starter $999 (40 customers), Proof $2,499 (100), Rollout $9,996 (400+). 100% refunded for no-shows.

## Endpoint
- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.eveoy.com/mcp
- MCP (legacy SSE): https://mcp.eveoy.com/sse  +  POST /sse/message
- Server card: https://mcp.eveoy.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## Tools
Read-only, anonymous unless noted.
- ask_eveoy — any question about Eveoy, grounded in the public knowledge base; also describes what this server can do
- get_case_studies — list case studies and lookbooks (links to the full write-ups on eveoy.com/newsletter)
- get_pricing — exact pilot price; inputs mirror eveoy.com/order (customers_per_location 20–1000, locations 1–50)
- start_checkout — create a Stripe Checkout link to buy a pilot (requires one-time sign-in)
- book_demo — link to book a live Eveoy demo or talk to the team
- check_order_status — look up the status of an existing order by reference
- search_directory — search the Eveoy business directory by name, city, or category
- get_business — fetch a single directory business listing
- claim_business — claim a directory listing to verify ownership and see its contacts
- list_industries — the 23+ sectors Eveoy serves
- list_metros — Eveoy directory coverage (Los Angeles live; more coming)
- get_app_link — the Eveoy shopper-app install link
- subscribe_newsletter — subscribe an email to the Eveoy newsletter

## Prompts
- /eveoy_price_quote, /eveoy_objection_handle, /pitch_for_role, /pilot_scope_intake
